item.title: Report: Tanker struck by two unidentified projectiles off Oman’s coast
item.description:
The United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) reported a maritime incident approximately 26 kilometers northeast of Lima, Oman.
According to the report, the tanker's company security officer said the vessel was struck by two unidentified projectiles that penetrated the engine room.
No casualties or environmental damage have been reported at this stage.

item.title: Lapid: Attempt to steal the election with help of government plants in defense establishment
item.description:
Opposition leader Yair Lapid sharply criticized Shin Bet Director David Zini over his request to investigate MKs from the Joint List and Ra'am on suspicion of electoral misconduct.
"What we are witnessing tonight is an attempt to crush democracy and steal the election with the help of government plants within the security establishment. This is a direct threat to our democracy from people who refuse to accept defeat. I call on all state institutions to stand firm against this attempt, and on my colleagues in our political camp to put everything else aside and form a government as quickly as possible," Lapid said.

item.title: Attorney General issues unusual statement: No one will be investigated without evidence
item.description:
Attorney General Gali Baharav-Miara clarified that citizens and elected officials cannot be investigated without evidence justifying such an investigation.
"If the Shin Bet or any other body possesses evidence warranting an investigation, it is welcome to present it. Anyone who needs to be investigated will be investigated," a statement issued on her behalf said.
The statement also alleged that the Shin Bet has failed for two days to transfer the evidence it collected to the special investigative team established on the recommendation of Justice Sohlberg, in cooperation with the police and under the supervision of the State Attorney's Office, thereby delaying the investigation.

item.title: High Court issues unusual ruling: Prison sentence suspended
item.description: The High Court has ruled that the young man convicted of killing Aisha al-Rabi in 2018 will not begin serving his prison sentence until his appeal has been decided.
